output.reason: [ev-5983baf3dd9a] is a troubleshooting entry in the 0.16 promotion guide. It names an error message and says the root cause is a failed CRD installation, but it never says what changed between 0.15 and 0.16, which environments are exposed or what an operator who does nothing would see as a result of the release. The rendered diffs (e.g. [ev-7a082965d61c] for externalsecrets.external-secrets.io) show spec.conversion (the Webhook strategy) removed from the CRDs. That is a separate change, and no source text links it to this error entry. Writing the subject, change, applicability and consequence would need an upstream statement that ties the error to a specific 0.16 change.
